metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded from 24 electrodes covering frontal, temporal, central, parietal and occipital sites (Fp1, Fp2, AF3, AF4, F7, Fz, F8, FC5, FC6, FT7, FT8, C3, Cz, C4, CP3, CP4, P3, Pz, P4, PO3, PO4, O1, Oz, O2). Each participant watched 2 resting scenes and 15 movement scenes, each with 20 trials of reciprocal periodic movement at fixed depth and velocity, and rated each movement scene afterwards. Events '11' and '13' correspond to resting-state segments and event '12' to task-state segments.
